title: Working at Tessl - Joe's Story
description:
At Tessl, a hobby project can become a major marketing campaign in just under a week. It's all about grassroots engineering culture—ideas flow freely, and those ideas are fast-tracked into fully-fledged features. No layers of bureaucracy stifle innovation here, making Tessl a breeding ground for rapid development and deployment. 

Joe Holdcroft, leading one of Tessl's software engineering teams, brings nearly two years of experience to the table. Having previously worked with colleagues from Snyk, Joe's journey at Tessl is marked by collaboration with top-tier talent. He emphasizes the empowering environment where engineers thrive, innovate, and constantly learn from one another in a rapidly evolving space.

What Joe talks about:
• Reuniting with former Snyk colleagues and its impact
• What it's like heading towards product market fit
• Why building tools for engineers is a unique opportunity
• How can a hobby project become a product in just under a week?
• The importance of experience during rapid industry changes
